name: qualitytrack-root
description: QualityTrack - API Testing & Quality Assurance Platform

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix demo-api install && npm --prefix frontend install
scripts.dev: concurrently -n "BACKEND,DEMO_API,FRONTEND" -c "blue,green,magenta" "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:demo" "npm run dev:frontend"
scripts.build: npm --prefix backend run build && npm --prefix demo-api run build && npm --prefix frontend run build
